caseNameFull: Hitt, Trading as Congressional Garage v. Cardillo, Deputy Commissioner
attorneys: Messrs. Chas. S. Baker, Warren E. Magee, and Benj. L. Tepper for petitioners. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Shea, and Messrs. Robert L. Stern and Christopher B. Garnett for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied.

Mr. Justice Rutledge took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
